findings.title: Email validation implemented in 3 places
findings.rationale: Three functions independently validate email format with equivalent logic.

sites.snippet:
def check_email(raw):
    return EMAIL_PATTERN.fullmatch(raw) is not None

def is_valid_email(s):
    return re.match(r'[^@]+@[^@]+', s) is not None

findings.suggestion: Consolidate into one helper and have the other two call it.

findings.title: Session setup repeated across two flows
findings.rationale: load_user, refresh_token and audit_login run in sequence in both user_login and password_reset.
findings.suggestion: Extract the three-call sequence into one begin_session helper.

findings.title: handle_request has a fan-out of 11
findings.rationale: handle_request calls 11 functions directly, above the fan-out threshold of 8.
findings.suggestion: Group the validation, persistence and notification calls into three helpers.

findings.title: legacy_export is not reached by any mapped flow
findings.rationale: Not reached by any of the 14 mapped flows — confirm before deleting. Tracing cannot see reflection, dependency injection or configuration-declared entry points.
findings.suggestion: Check for dynamic callers and configuration references, then decide.
